admissionInfo.text: To be admitted to the BSCE program a student must complete the following courses with a minimum grade of C in these courses and a grade point average of 2.5 or above. A student not meeting all of the admission requirements may request in writing, a provisional admission status for a semester from the department. the provisional admission status must be approved by the computer engineering program coordinator.
